subject: general
question: Which of the following is a key advantage of using Thyristors in power control applications?

options.text: High efficiency and low power loss

solution:
__**Concept**__

A thyristor is a four-layer (PNPN) semiconductor device used mainly as a controlled switch for high-power applications.

Once turned ON, it continues to conduct until the current falls below a certain minimum value.

**Advantages:**

__
 
• Can handle high voltage and current
 
• Low power gate control
 
• **High efficiency and low power loss**

**Explanation**__

**High efficiency and low power loss**

 
• Thyristors have a low ON-state voltage drop
 
• This results in very small conduction losses
 
• Hence, they are highly efficient in power control applications
 
• That’s why they are widely used in high-power rectifiers, AC controllers, and motor drives
